steps.description: Load and parse stock data from CSV files using d3.csv() or Node.js fs + d3-dsv
Create bubble chart with D3 force simulation — size by market cap, color by sector, cluster by sector

suggestions: Fix initial node positions deterministically (e.g., sorted nodes on a grid) before running the force simulation.
Run exactly N fixed ticks (simulation.stop(); for (let i=0;i<N;i++) simulation.tick()) for reproducibility.
warnings: Never use Math.random() for initial positions — the output must be deterministic across runs.

steps.description: Vendor D3 library locally — do not load from CDN; pin to a specific version

constraints.requirement: pin to d3@7.9.0 and vendor the bundle locally

failure_patterns.reason: ❌ Do not load D3 from a CDN. The task environment has no network access. Vendor a pinned D3 bundle locally (e.g., vendor/d3.v7.9.0.min.js) and reference it with a relative path.

steps.description: Add interactivity — tooltips on hover, click handlers for selection, bidirectional linking with data table
Ensure output is deterministic — sort data, fix positions, use stable IDs, no random/Date calls

failure_patterns.reason: ❌ Do not use Math.random() — visualization output must be deterministic. Use deterministic initial positions (e.g., place nodes on a grid sorted by sector and market cap).

steps.description: Export as standalone HTML with all assets inlined or vendored — no external dependencies
